description: Search products, manage your cart, and retrieve purchases using your own signed-in session.

novel_features.name: Confirmed cart results
novel_features.description: Reports the resulting cart after the requested change.

novel_features.name: Exact cart line targeting
novel_features.description: Updates one explicit cart line and confirms its quantity.

novel_features.name: Honest product availability
novel_features.description: Returns concrete products and marks absent availability unknown.

novel_features.name: Complete order history
novel_features.description: Lists orders across bounded pages in the requested date range.

novel_features.name: Verified session status
novel_features.description: Distinguishes stored session presence from a verified signed-in read.
